symptom: `mxcli syntax workflow user-task` (and workflow.user-task) printed an index of the topic and its one subtopic instead of the user task syntax; the index's own hint line suggested that same command.
cause: Lookup resolves the path exactly and returns ByPrefix(path): the topic plus everything under it. WriteText prints full detail only for exactly one feature, so a topic with a subtopic was always shown as an index.
fix: Match.WriteText: a nested (dotted) topic that exists in its own right prints its detail, then lists its subtopics. A top-level area (workflow, microflow) stays an index. The CLI and the REPL help both render through it.
insight: A lookup that answers with a set loses the distinction between 'this topic' and 'this topic and its children'; the renderer guessed from the count. 13 nested topics had the same blind spot (domain-model.entity, page..., navigation.menu-document); list them from `syntax --json` rather than trusting the reported one.
test: cmd/mxcli/syntax/topic_parent_2238_test.go TestMatchWriteText_ParentTopicShowsItsDetail (controls: a leaf topic, and the top-level workflow index)
